scope: PDF image-layer rules reviewed against the locally supplied ISO_32000-2_sponsored_EC3.txt (ISO 32000-2:2020, errata collection 3): 8.9.3-8.9.7, Tables 87, 88, 90-92; 7.4.6/Table 11, 7.4.7/Table 12, 7.4.8/Table 13, 7.4.9 and 11.6.4.3. This revision additionally checks JPEG entropy padding and application segment framing against local itu-t81-1992.txt B.1.1.4-5, B.2.4.6/Table B.9 and E.1.4; Group 4 EOFB/padding against itu-t6-1988.txt 2.4.1.1-2; and JP2 sample placement and channel definitions against itu-t800-2019.txt B.2, G.4 and I.5.3.6. These are scoped rule reviews, not verification of the complete JPEG/fax/JPEG 2000 algorithms. Adobe Technical Note 5116 remains pending; the JPX/paint registries record the subsequently reviewed baseline-container, colour-selection and ICC subsets and their remaining boundaries. T.81/T.4/T.6/T.88/T.800 are now locally available; unreviewed algorithms remain pending as detailed below. Resource budgets follow ADR 0010, not an ISO numerical limit. This revision additionally reviews ISO 32000-2:2020 7.3.9, 7.3.8.1/Table 5, 7.4.1 and 7.4.9 (optional/null filter parameters), 8.9.5.1/Table 87 and 8.9.6.2 (stencil colour), and 8.9.7/Table 92 (the XObject abbreviation prohibition) against the same local ISO text; final entropy-segment MCU counts and EOI are reviewed against local itu-t81-1992.txt B.2.1. Recovery choices are explicit departures, not normative permissions. Additional wrapper rules checked against the same local ISO text: 7.3.8.1 Table 5 and 8.9.7 Tables 91-92 permit an empty inline Filter array; 7.4.6 Table 11 fixes the encoded fax row width, and 8.9.5.1 Table 87 fixes the image sample grid. Mismatched fax widths use an explicit reported recovery rather than an ISO-defined correction.

choices.reason: PDF 7.4.8 specifies byte components without a reduction rule for twelve-bit JPEG. This is a reader policy, not an ISO-prescribed normalization.
choices.compatibility: Poppler 24.02.0 pdfimages reconstructs the eight-bit arithmetic fixture within one level, but extracts all-white samples for these twelve-bit Huffman fixtures. Source inspection of Hayro 0.8.0’s zune-jpeg 0.5.15 dependency finds non-eight-bit precision rejected. Neither establishes a portable twelve-bit-to-PDF-byte conversion rule.

requirements.verdict: Implemented at the JPEG and PDF image adapter boundary.

requirements.status: Huffman non-hierarchical process implemented; hosted acceptance passed at c50727d340db1236c98eb769e002771d680e790a
requirements.gaps: Arithmetic lossless and hierarchical processes remain explicit compatibility boundaries. Shared frame/scan handling implements DNL before allocation; 20cf hosted acceptance passed, while the performance-base integration awaits fresh gates. Lossless JPEG is a compatibility extension beyond PDF 7.4.8 required baseline/progressive byte processes. Pinned PDFium accepts the three diagnostic 8-bit Huffman controls; no tested baseline passes the two 16-bit or five arithmetic subjects. Poppler paired controls fail, so its subjects remain unadjudicated. See benchmarks/probes/README.md for exact diagnostic source/run/artifact identities.

review.locator: T.81 H.1.1, H.1.2/Table H.1-H.3 and H.2
review.rule: Lossless coding predicts unsigned 2–16-bit samples without a level shift, encodes modulo-65536 differences, and restores a point transform. Scan/restart starts use the reduced-precision midpoint. Row starts and first rows select their boundary predictors; other positions use the declared predictor with full intermediate integer precision and arithmetic half-difference shifts. Huffman category16 has no appended magnitude bits; arithmetic contexts use differences above and left and reset at scan/restart boundaries.
review.verdict: The existing frame/Huffman/scan/output owners now handle lossless Huffman precision 2 through 16, all predictors, point transforms, interleaved and separate scans, four table selectors and integer/fractional sampling. Independent original grids cover every precision and predictor; literal codewords separately pin category16 without appended bits, negative arithmetic half-shifts and overflowing predictions. Malformed process fields, missing/duplicate scans, invalid difference categories and out-of-range samples are Syntax; storage/work/pixel limits and every truncated prefix are bounded. Arithmetic lossless remains an explicit compatibility boundary.

review.rule: Lossless data units are individual samples. The component sampling ratios determine its sample grid; interleaved partial MCUs carry padding samples, which output crops. Tq and AC selector are zero, Ss selects predictor1-7, Se and Ah are zero, and Pt is smaller than sample precision. Restart intervals span whole MCU rows.
review.verdict: Independent planar/interleaved, cropped 2x2 and fractional 3:2:1 layouts, restart and distinct-table controls exercise the same container/scan owners as DCT images.

choices.choice: Map the restored native unsigned sample range to bytes with one full-range rounding after any colour transform; retain the encoded sample grid as the independent oracle.
choices.reason: PDF 7.4.8 specifies byte components and baseline/progressive JPEG without prescribing lossless/high-precision adaptation. This is the same declared normalization policy as twelve-bit DCT, not a normative PDF requirement. Independent full-page controls and public ImageSource/native/WASI/browser paths must validate it.

requirements.status: Implemented; full three-OS, native/WASI/browser and 260-control hosted acceptance passed at 6e87a6030ae206322aa813388b41e18363d5af81; exact reports are in benchmarks/probes/README.md.
requirements.gaps: Hosted acceptance of this extension batch is pending. Selectors 0..6 have no defined T.4/T.6 coding and remain Unsupported. This does not enable T.88-forbidden uncompressed coding in JBIG2 MMR.

review.rule: Selector 111 enters raw coding. Literal words represent zero through four white pixels followed by black, or five white pixels. Exit words append zero through four white pixels and specify the following run colour.
review.verdict: Literal codeword/pixel pairs exercise both entrances, every word and both exit colours. Resumed horizontal, vertical and pass coding uses the existing row transitions and reference line.

review.rule: An uncompressed pattern can span several unbroken T.6 rows. Output rows remain independently byte padded; row counts, EOFB, polarity and resource limits retain their PDF meaning. A literal cannot be interrupted by an encoded line marker or byte fill.
review.verdict: Widths 1, 2, 3, 5 and 7 force within-word continuation; native pixel subjects and matched RGB controls cover rendering. Framed rows require the raw mode exit before their framing; malformed crossings are Syntax. No second sample plane is allocated.

review.rule: The 1-D uncompressed entrance cannot immediately follow a codeword ending in 000.
review.verdict: The parser rejects this EOL ambiguity; literal independent controls pin the refusal.

requirements.resource_contract: The width-one twenty-row vector charges 45 bit/lookahead operations:10 entrance+21 literal-code bits+8 exit+6 initial optional-EOL lookahead. Live decoded storage is6*sizeof(usize)+21 bytes for the two transition lists, spare row and twenty output rows; the exact boundary succeeds and one-short work/storage/pixels/input bounds refuse. Expected pixels and bounds are not inferred from engine output.
